stem: In the selections “A Ghostly New Creature” and “Tiptoeing Scientists,” how are Michael Vecchione’s work and Marcio Pie’s work different?

options.label: F
options.text: Vecchione uses high-tech equipment to observe animals, but Pie does not.

options.label: G
options.text: Vecchione studies animals that can be difficult to find, but Pie does not.

options.label: H
options.text: Pie is employed by a government agency, but Vecchione is self-employed.

options.label: J
options.text: Pie conducts research about many kinds of animals, but Vecchione studies only octopods.
